sections.title: ✨ New
items: Added new **Product quiz** section.
Added new **Video section**.
Added new **Video with text** section.
Added new **Tag block** to Product details section on Product pages.
Added blog **Tag glossary** feature for categorizing blog posts.

sections.title: 🐛 Fixes
items: Fixed a bug where product image swatches intercepted clicks that should have gone to the primary product images.

sections.title: ✨ New
items: Added **In-cart product upsells**, allowing merchants to suggest complementary items directly in the cart.
Added support for showing **Color swatches on product cards**.
Added an option to display all footer blocks as accordions on mobile.
Added heading text control to the Collection banner section.

sections.title: 🛠️ Improvements
items: Updated theme translations to includes the follow languages: German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Swedish, and Simplified Chinese.

sections.title: 🐛 Fixes
items: Fixed an issue where transparent logos did not appear correctly in some Safari browsers.
Fixed missing rich text (RTE) styles within product accordion blocks.
Fixed an issue causing text to be cut off in buttons with low height.
Fixed a duplication issue with the account button in mobile headers when the navigation is positioned below a centered logo.

sections.title: ✨ New
items: Added Section level color scheme setting to the **Facet grid** section.
Added optional column control to image grid block in the **Footer** section.
Added optional custom width controls for Headings and Text to all sections with prelude content.
Added optional custom icon settings for all Product details blocks that support icons.

sections.title: 🐛 Fixes
items: Fixed the line in the Space and line block not appearing consistently depending on layout.
Fixed Shop the look section sticky offset not offsetting properly when header layout.
